title: pychivalry suite record
description: One run of a suite that needs game files, made by a local task and committed. The format is described in records/README.md; `task records:check` validates every record against this schema and checks that its spec is the committed one.

record_format.description: The version of this format. A change that a reader of the old format would misread raises it.

command.description: The command that made the record, with `<game dir>` and `<corpus dir>` in place of local paths.

made_at.description: When the record was made, in UTC.

game.description: The installed game the run read; null for the judge's calibration (scored:calibration), which reads no game.

corpus.description: The mod corpus the run read, or null for a suite that reads no mods.

notes.description: What a reader must know to interpret the results, in plain sentences.

results.description: The suite's results. Each suite's shape is defined with the step that builds the suite; a stub writes an empty object.

roundTrip.description: The formatter's round trip (records/README.md, "Parse records"; docs/PLAN.md item 8.3): files formatted, left as they are, changed; trees, tokens and comments the same; a second format unchanged; how much the formatter changes, by rule; the 120-column rule; the time.

parseResults.description: The base-game parse suite (records/README.md, "Parse records"): the folders read, every parse error with its classification, the information notes, the text files not read, how every text file of the game is encoded, and the formatter's round trip over the script files read and the localization files.

duplicates.description: The names defined more than once: how many, by how each resolves, and the unknown ones (winner not known) by the open rule of docs/overrides.md, by reason and by database.

unknown_by_reason.description: no-rule, not-settled:<row>, no-order, file-unknown:<question> (records/README.md, Index records).

notDescribed.description: The .txt and .yml files in folders the spec does not describe, by folder; beside_spec_folders is true for a folder whose first folder also holds folders the spec lists.

indexResults.description: The base-game index suite (records/README.md, "Index records"): the base game indexed in every folder the spec lists, its cache saved and reloaded, and each corpus mod indexed over it.

rules.description: The rules table the run used: the core's digest of the spec package's override rules (part D1).

tool.description: The build of pychivalry that made the record.

commit.description: The git commit the tool was built from. A 2.3.0 baseline names the commit that last changed legacy/.

dirty.description: True when tracked files outside records/ differed from that commit. For a 2.3.0 baseline: when the build copy differed from legacy/ in a file the baseline does not write on purpose.

machine.description: The machine, described generically: nothing that identifies it or its owner.

game.description: The installed game the run read.

build.description: The game build, from the launcher's settings file (`rawVersion`).

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the game's file manifest, defined in records/README.md.

spec.description: The spec package the run used.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the package's uncompressed bytes.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of records/corpus/MANIFEST.tsv as committed when the run was made.

checkFinding.description: An error or a warning of a check suite: the file relative to its mod or its base-game layer, the layer (base game only), the line and column from 1, its code and message, and, where the suite classifies it, its classification and the reason (tools/data/check-classifications.json, tools/data/mods-classifications.json).

classCounts.description: How many listed findings have each classification: game-defect for the base game, real-defect for a mod.

scopeFigures.description: What the scope checks judged (records/README.md, "Check records"): keyword uses seen, with a known scope, judged against the scope data, the findings, the uses not judged by why; link steps judged and their findings.

cappedFiles.description: The per-file cap on findings (records/README.md, "Check records"): its size, the files it shortened, the findings it dropped in all and by code.

checkResults.description: The base-game check suite (records/README.md, "Check records"): every check on the base game's own files, every error and warning classified, information and hints counted, the scope figures, release 2.3.0's figures beside them, time and peak memory.

modsResults.description: The real-mod check suite (records/README.md, "Check records"): per corpus mod, every check, every error classified, every warning listed, information and hints counted, the scope figures, release 2.3.0's results on it beside them, time and peak memory.

baseline_2_3_0.description: Release 2.3.0's results on the mod, from records/baseline-2.3.0/results-mods.json; null when that record has no such mod.

baselineResults.description: What release 2.3.0 found in one run: on the base game (vanilla-acceptance) or on each corpus mod (corpus-acceptance). records/README.md, "Result baselines".

context.description: Facts that are not results: the Node flags, the load average before the run, exit codes.

baselineError.description: One error-severity finding of release 2.3.0 on the base game: the file relative to the game folder, the line from 1, its code and its message as 2.3.0 wrote it.

baselineParseError.description: One parse error of release 2.3.0 on the base game, with its column from 1.

baselineModError.description: One error-severity finding of release 2.3.0 on a mod: the file relative to the mod folder, the line from 1, its code, its message, and what 2.3.0's own classification file says of it.

scope.description: How much of the base game release 2.3.0's scope check could judge.

speedResults.description: Timings and memory of one or more series of runs.

series.description: Repeated runs of one measurement on one input.

method.description: How the runs were made; records/README.md describes each method.

mod.description: The corpus slug, or null for the base game alone.

runs.description: Every run, in the order made; the first is the first run after a fresh process.

context.description: Facts about the runs that are not measures (file counts, editor version, load average).

first.description: The first run of the series. Not a cold start: see the record's notes.

stats.description: The runs after the first: their median and spread (max minus min), and every value.

scoredResults.description: A scored run (records/README.md, "Scored records"): the harness, the model, each trial's tool calls, tool errors and grades, and the pass rate per task.

task.description: The task: its committed prompt and planted-defect fixture, each by its hash.

harness.description: The harness: Claude Code, its version as `claude --version` gives it.

model.description: The model, by its full name, never an alias.

session_limit.description: The session limit each test session was given (SCORED_SESSION_LIMIT), passed to Claude Code, which ends a session early when it is reached.

timeout_minutes.description: The time limit after which the run stops a test session.

arguments.description: Claude Code's arguments, with the prompt file and the agent-server configuration named, not given.

tasks.description: Per task: its trials, the trials that passed, the pass rate (passed / trials, to 4 places), and the owner's target with whether the run met it (absent in a record made before the target was set).

target.description: The owner's target (docs/decisions.md, decision 82): every test session passes. run: release for 10 trials or more, else development (fewer than all passing is looked into); needs: the trials that must pass, all of them; met: whether every trial passed.

trial.description: One trial of a scored run: one test session of Claude Code.

passed.description: No harness problem, and every grader passed.

stopped.description: What ended the test session: finished (by itself), session-limit (Claude Code ended it at the session limit), turns, error, timeout (the run's time limit), no-result (the stream has no end).

harness_problems.description: What makes the trial say nothing about the server: a session that broke or was not confined.

tool_calls.description: Per tool: its calls, and how many of them ended in an error.

tool_errors.description: Each tool error, its text with the trial's folders named and no other path.

session.description: What the session was offered, from its init event; null when the stream has none.

skills.description: The skills offered, by name: none, when the session is confined.

plugins.description: The plugins loaded, each by its source (<name>@<marketplace>) or name: when the session is confined, only Claude Code's own (<name>@builtin).

findings_left.description: What the checker still reports on the trial's mod, by severity.

judgeRecord.description: The judge's part of an authoring trial or a calibration item: its session's end and problems, and its answer per dimension, or why there is none. The judge's reasons are never recorded.

state.description: answered: every question answered; malformed: the session answered, not in the answer's shape; not-judged: no judge was asked, or its session said nothing.

answers.description: One per question the request asks, in its order, when answered; otherwise none.

validity.description: Grade one of an authoring trial: pychivalry's checker on the result, over the base game.

in_format.description: No warning of the family style/: the result is in pychivalry's format.

by_code.description: The errors and warnings by code.

authoringTrial.description: One trial of a scored authoring run: one authoring test session of Claude Code, then one judge test session on what it left.

harness_held.description: Neither the authoring session nor the judge's had a harness problem.

expectations.description: Each expectation of the request, in its order, checked in code.

measures.description: The measures of a set of authoring trials: every count but trials and harness_held is over the trials whose harness held.

authoringResults.description: A scored authoring run (records/README.md, "Scored records"): the harness, the models, each trial's session, grades and judge, and the measures per request and over all. No target: the record states measures only, and the owner's targets (docs/decisions.md, decision 127) are read from them.

task.description: The task: its committed request list, prompts, judge schema, base mods and skills, each by its hash.

judge_session_limit.description: The session limit each judge test session was given.

agreement.description: How the judge agreed with the hand grades over a set of them: the grades, those the judge answered, those it answered as the person did, agree / judged (null when it answered none), how often each said cannot-tell, and the table of hand answer against judge answer.

calibrationResults.description: The judge's calibration (records/README.md, "Scored records"): the judge run over results graded by hand, and its agreement per dimension and over all.

grades.description: The hand grades, by their file and its hash.

items.description: One hand-graded result and the judge's answer on it.
